question: Which of the following diseases is found commonly among workers in underground subways?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage, near the end, highlights the observations of scholars who found that employees working on the platforms of Stockholm underground (an example of an underground subway) had higher levels of risk markers for cardiovascular disease compared to ticket sellers and train drivers.
 
• This mention indicates that cardiovascular disease is a risk for workers in underground subways, especially those working on platforms where particulate matter concentrations are highest.
 
• Therefore, 'Option 3' (Cardiovascular) is the correct answer as it aligns with the health risk highlighted in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 1' (Abdominal), 'Option 2' (Renal), and 'Option 4' (Pulmonary) diseases are not mentioned in the passage in relation to subway workers. The text does not discuss any link between these health issues and working in underground subways.
 
• Therefore, these options cannot be validated based on the content of the passage.
